experimentUnit: One independently capable recipient; two future preregistered fresh job pairs

reconstruction.scope: Own Swagger 2 response inventory built before donor access
reconstruction.limitations: Includes small GTFS context switches, public tool search/testing; not measured human effort or token bill.

transferIntegration.scope: Read donor public module and construct/test wrapper on discovery only
transferIntegration.limitations: First donor read immediately preceded recorded clock. Measured command wall is contained inside integration interval, not additional elapsed time.

freshDelivery.interpretation: The only fresh executed pair has zero structural changed tuples. No new recipient capability, quality gain or execution-time gain demonstrated; no fresh changed-node provenance case.

donorConstruction.source: Campaign owner records shared donor capability construction and failed discovery separately
donorConstruction.rule: Charge once at enterprise level, or allocate across true recipients/reuses; do not count receiving a duplicate as new capability.

reuseAndMaintenance.actualScope: Swagger 2 source family; no measured later maintenance yet
reuseAndMaintenance.integrationBurden: Versioned module import, CLI wrapper, initial verification, update policy and fresh-input validation
reuseAndMaintenance.scarcity: Fast independent reconstruction is evidence against treating the basic scoped inventory as scarce.

costInterpretation: No total actual dollar cost or human savings asserted. Null means unknown, not zero. Authoring session times must not be priced as human labor without an explicit model.
measurementLimitations: maxRssKiB from RUSAGE_CHILDREN is a cumulative child high-water mark in the runner, an upper bound rather than a separately isolated per-arm peak.
Command wall times are contained within construction/integration session intervals; do not sum them as additional authoring elapsed time.

secondaryExploratoryDelivery.interpretation: Existing strict raw-validation gate stopped before original/full/incremental execution. Validation failure cost retained. Standards/tool-source review does not change HOLD or establish whole-document validity.
